name: Cinthia Marcelle's Final Weekend
description: This is your last chance to experience 'beginning, middle, beginning,' the first solo exhibition in Portugal by celebrated Brazilian artist Cinthia Marcelle. Catch this compelling show at Serralves before it closes.
longDescription:
This event marks the closing weekend for 'beginning, middle, beginning,' the inaugural solo exhibition in Portugal by Brazilian artist Cinthia Marcelle. The exhibition at Serralves Museum presents a collection of works that explore themes of repetition, transformation, and the cyclical nature of existence through various media. Marcelle is known for her site-specific installations and performances that often involve everyday materials and engage with architectural spaces.

Visitors to Serralves on this final weekend will have the opportunity to engage with Marcelle's artistic approach. The exhibition is housed within the contemporary galleries of the Serralves Museum, offering a contemplative environment for viewing the works. The experience is self-guided, allowing individuals to explore at their own pace. The museum typically attracts a diverse audience, including art enthusiasts, students, and general visitors interested in contemporary culture.

Access to the exhibition is included with general admission to the Serralves Museum. Tickets can be purchased at the museum entrance. Serralves is located in Porto and can be reached by bus lines 201, 203, 207, 502, and 504, with stops directly outside the museum grounds. The museum facilities are generally accessible.
